test_objective: Check that you cannot update a subscription: Any attempt to remove (by setting them to null in the Fragment) mandatory properties of a Subscription (clause 5.2.12) shall result in an error of type BadRequestData

test_cases.name: 029_04_01 Update Subscription With Null Mandatory Properties
test_cases.doc: Check that you cannot update a subscription: Any attempt to remove (by setting them to null in the Fragment) mandatory properties of a Subscription (clause 5.2.12) shall result in an error of type BadRequestData
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/subscriptions/{subscription_id}'
        method set to 'PATCH'
        Request Update Subscription and 
Header['Content-Type'] set to 'application/json' and
Payload defined in file 'subscriptions/fragments/subscription-null-properties-update.json'
}
